Possible sightings of sea lions and dolphins

No more than 400 lbs combined weight on any watercraft

blurb: Guests check in at the green pier in Avalon Harbor, receive safety briefing and training, then are shuttled to the Jet Ski Barge for one hour of jet ski riding in an open ocean area. Lifejackets and dry storage are provided. The ride area covers about 10 square miles and guests may see sea lions or dolphins.
extraNote: Booking is non-refundable if under the influence of drugs or alcohol at check in · Tips are greatly appreciated · Reservations highly recommended July through September · Weather may impact the excursion; contact operator in case of inclement weather · Any cancellation or "No Show" done within 24 hours of the rental time will not be refundable unless management cancels due to unsafe weather conditions, at which time a full refund will be issued back to the credit card used to purchase the rental. · The Shore Boat will depart at the scheduled tour time, if you are late and arrive after the Shore Boat has departed you will be marked as a "No Show" and your reservation is not refundable. ##Than
